description: This file defines the OrleansDefaultHasher class, which implements the IHasher interface to provide a default hashing function used in Orleans grain placement. It utilizes the StableHash.ComputeHash method to generate hash values.

classes.name: OrleansDefaultHasher
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IHasher that provides a default hash function for Orleans grains.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the hash function used by OrleansDefaultHasher.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes and returns the hash value for the given byte array using StableHash.
